## What he does

- Business intelligence and data visualization: dashboards and reports in Tableau and
  Power BI, KPI definition, data storytelling for non-technical audiences
- Analytical SQL over enterprise sources (Snowflake, SAP HANA, BigQuery, relational
  databases) and data preparation with pandas, Power Query and Tableau Prep
- Design and implementation of REST APIs and microservice architectures
- Backend systems for regulated and high-volume domains: interbank messaging
  (SWIFT / ISO 20022 MT files), electronic invoicing, inventory and benefits platforms
- Database modelling and query optimization (PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis)
- Data engineering: ETL pipelines, batch processing, reporting and BI
- Infrastructure and delivery: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS), CI/CD,
  GitHub Actions, Nginx, Linux server administration

## Experience

- BI & Data Analytics Intern — Keyrus Colombia S.A.S. (Aug 2026 – present): Visualization
  team inside the BI & Data Analytics practice; interactive dashboards in Tableau and
  Power BI for retail, telecom, healthcare, energy and public-sector clients; analytical
  SQL over Snowflake, SAP HANA and BigQuery; data preparation with pandas, Power Query
  and Tableau Prep; documentation of KPI definitions and analytical methodologies.
- Fullstack Developer — TotalDev SAS (Jul 2025 – Mar 2026): interbank messaging system
  processing MT files with encryption validation and SWIFT/ISO 20022 routing; inventory
  backends with region-based RBAC; QR generation and validation; Laravel + Filament CMS.
- Fullstack Developer — PARQ (Nov 2024 – Jul 2025): NestJS + TypeORM microservices;
  electronic invoicing middleware integrating Siigo, Alegra and SATCOM; queue-based bulk
  loading and scheduled jobs; Swagger/OpenAPI documentation; Docker + Portainer deploys.
- Backend Developer — SEREMPRE (Jan 2023 – Nov 2024): corporate benefits platform for
  multiple Latin American countries; complex MySQL queries and stored procedures;
  migration of legacy systems to Docker (DDEV); Cloudinary and Moodle LTI integrations.

## Hiring and how to get in touch

## How to start a project

Send a short description of the problem, the stack in use and the deadline. He
replies with scope questions, then a written proposal with phases and estimates
before any code is written. Engagements range from one-off APIs, data pipelines
and integrations to ongoing backend ownership, either directly or through
Vulcano for larger builds that need a team.
